title: security: a permission set's own readable:false field row must win over that same set's View All field vote (amend ADR-0066 D2 ⑧)
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5

**Maintainer ruling (Irene, decision card in the hotcrm project, tapped 2026-11-15 11:44 UTC): A, platform.** An explicit `readable: false` field-permission row on a permission set must win over that **same set's** View All (`viewAllRecords`) field vote. This amends ADR-0066 D2 ⑧ as amended by ruling of record 6573563853.

## What happens today (measured on 18.4.0)

- `superuserFieldVote` (`packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts`) has a set that holds `viewAllRecords` on an object vote `readable: true` on every field of that object. `PermissionEvaluator.getFieldPermissions` and `buildEffectiveFieldPermissions` apply it after the declared-entry votes.
- So a set cannot give View All on an object and still hide some of its fields. Its own `fields` rows are out-voted by its own object row.
- Measured by the hotcrm PSA thread: `project_member` holds read with View All on `crm_account`, plus `readable: false` rows for the account's Order to Cash totals (`invoiced_amount`, `received_amount`, `receivable_balance`). A consultant still reads all three over REST and in the console.

## Why it matters

- Ruling 6573563853 fixed a real case: a platform admin was hidden from a field by another set's `false`. That case is about **other** sets and stays as it is.
- The gap is the same-set case. Every View All set that also tries to narrow fields silently loses the narrowing, so a declared field mask is not enforced (declared ≠ enforced).
- Mainstream reference: Salesforce and Dynamics keep field-level security independent of record-level View All / organization-wide read.

## Asked

- In the field merge, a set's own explicit `readable: false` (or `editable: false`) row on `<object>.<field>` is not overridden by that set's own View All / Modify All vote on `<object>`.
- Another set's super-user vote still wins over this set's `false`, keeping ruling 6573563853's admin case. Whether Modify All should get the same treatment as View All is part of this card's design; the ruling names View All.
- ADR-0066 D2 ⑧ is amended in the same PR.
- **Lint, same PR:** the rule `security-superuser-field-mask-inert` fires today. Under `objectstack lint --strict`, hotcrm's three rows give 3 warnings, `permission set "project_member": viewAllRecords on objects.crm_account votes on every field of "crm_account", so readable: false on 'crm_account.invoiced_amount' binds none of this set's holders`, at `permissions[6].fields[...]`. After the fix, the rule must stop flagging a row that its own set's View All no longer out-votes. Today the rows cannot even land, because they turn the consumer's strict lint red.
- Tests: a View All set with a `readable: false` row hides the field from its holder, both in `getFieldPermissions` and in `/auth/me/permissions`. A second set holding Modify All on the object still reveals it.

## Consumer

hotcrm#2481 (`pm:blocked` on this card) adds the three `project_member` rows once a release carries the fix. Until then, consultants see the totals.

Governing text: ADR-0066 D2 ⑧ (as amended, ruling of record 6573563853); `superuserFieldVote` docblock.
